reviews.text: Dogs get excited about walks. Rud gives guidance on what's best for the dogs, and he's patient and loving. I recommend him!
Great, humble, hardworking, patient, and caring guy. Thank you so much, my friend, for taking such good care of my dogs. I always recommend you to everyone... thank you, friend...
The moon starts jumping for joy when she hears the name Rud. When there's an outing, her day is much better.
Excellent professional! My dog ​​really enjoys the walks, and Rud also took great care of him during a trip.

I highly recommend Rud as a dog walker and cat sitter! Having a trustworthy person who cares for our pets with love and attention is invaluable. During the many times I was traveling, or even during my dog's daily walks, he was incredibly available and even sent me super cute pictures to reassure me and ease my longing for him because of the distance! Not to mention that my dog ​​adores him and gets very excited when she sees him! And even my cat, who is super shy and timid, managed to create a very interesting bond with him in my absence! You can trust this amazing professional.
Super reliable! Caring with pets! I highly recommend!
The best dog walker and pet sitter in the region. There's no pet that doesn't adore Uncle Rud!
